prompt_head:
Job: Configuration Specialist II at CentralReach
<requirements>
- (required) 1–3 years of experience in a technical configuration, implementation, or SaaS opera

output.summary: Systems architect with 4+ years building full-stack platforms, business automation tools, and AI agent workflows. Ships LangGraph agents end to end with human approval steps, LLM evals, and validated database-layer pipelines that eliminated 98% of transactional and invoicing errors. Built an operations CRM module and onboarding integration blueprints for high-value enterprise clients at Linkme. Military supply accountability sets the attention to detail that multi-step account configuration requires.

bullets.text: Built and deployed linkme-intops, an operations CRM module on React, TypeScript, and Cloudflare Workers that gives staff a dedicated interface for high-value subscription accounts.
Designed integration blueprints and live demo environments that reliably onboarded high-value enterprise clients onto the core platform.
Engineered custom data ingestion modules and analytics pipelines for VIP workflows, cutting service delivery times by over 30%.
Built database-layer automated data validation pipelines that eliminated 98% of transactional and invoicing errors.
Led end-to-end modernization from legacy desktop systems to cloud-native web infrastructure, cutting manual data processing overhead by 68%.
Built Job Fit Agent, a LangGraph agent that scores job postings against an evidence base using RAG on pgvector and drafts documents behind a human approval step.
Enforced evidence-cited outputs with a mostly deterministic verify loop and layered prompt injection defense; eval gates in CI require zero unsupported claims and passing injection tests.
Shipped the agent with FastAPI, a React/TypeScript dashboard, Postgres, Langfuse tracing, a daily cost cap, Docker, and GitHub Actions CI with 70 tests and an eval gate.
Built tycodes-pipeline, a staged Python pipeline that finds local businesses via Google Places, with a Google Sheets CRM and draft-only outreach behind human approval.
Secured 50+ qualified meetings per month against a daily team quota of 2, setting an organizational record of 120+ booked meetings in one month.
Mentored and onboarded incoming representatives to reach 15%+ conversion rate benchmarks.
Managed $100M+ in high-value federal inventory across 12 regional sites serving 8,000+ personnel daily, maintaining 100% audit accuracy while cutting processing times by 35%.
Enforced accountability procedures to eliminate supply chain bottlenecks during high-demand deployment rotations; awarded the Army Achievement Medal (2018) for operational excellence.
